title: Four Ways an Agent Gets It Wrong
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Four field-guide cards for the agent error types, each with what it looks like, how a reviewer catches it, and how a prompt prevents it, plus the worked example "A 9 that should be a 5".

educational.topic: The four types of AI agent error: factual, license, citation, and scoring
learningObjectives: The learner will classify an agent error as factual, license, citation, or scoring, and name the reviewer check and the prompt fix for it.
prerequisites: Hallucination and agent error types from [Chapter 14](../../chapters/14-checking-agent-output/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What kind of mistake could this be?
commonMisconceptions: A fluent report is a correct report
An agent's evidence is always real
assessmentOpportunities: A reference does not exist. Which error type is it?
What do you do to catch a scoring error?
How can a prompt prevent a license error?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
